authorization: 2026-10-28 사용자: 야간동안 TabPFN을 이용한 분류 개선 모델 고안, 앙상블/문헌 기반 구조 실험 및 보고서 작성

panel.weights: Each class has weight full_test_class_count / sampled_class_count. Panel F1 is an estimate, not exact full-test F1.

sampling: Original (not globally conflict-filtered) train and original outer test from EXP89. Exactly the same attack IDs, nested n prefixes, and first n benign IDs as EXP89. fixed750 adds 730 train-only benign IDs to the existing 20; its benign set is constant across n within seed. All methods in a condition share the same unique label budget.
folds: Exact float32 feature vectors are groups, including conflicting labels. StratifiedGroupKFold, 2 folds for n=2/3 and 3 for n>=5. No feature group crosses fold boundaries. Missing fold-training classes get probability zero and are audited; no validation rows or labels are added.
xgb_selection: Minimum class-balanced OOF negative log likelihood, before any test predictions; fixed grid, 300 trees/lr.05/subsample.8/colsample.8 otherwise unchanged.
pfn: Existing frozen TabPFN-v3 checkpoint, 4 estimators (16 only named reference), fit_with_cache, CPU cache, no subsampling and no weight updates. Full-context Global always retains every supplied example.
views: Signed log1p on all features except protocol/L7, flags, TTL, ICMP/DNS type and FTP response fields. No new features or whole-pool statistics. This is an experimental view inspired by multi-view inference, not a reproduction of TabFM+.
hierarchy: P(benign)=binary gate probability; P(attack family)=P(attack)*attack-only PFN family probability. Compare full PFN hierarchy, PFN gate/XGB attack specialist, and all-XGB hierarchy.
mixture: Expert bank [OOF-selected XGB, full PFN, log-view PFN, PFN hierarchy]. Compare fixed means, global simplex weights learned from class-balanced OOF NLL with L2=0.01 toward uniform, and feature-dependent softmax mixture learned from the same OOF predictions with L2=0.1. Gate features are confidence/entropy/margin/benign probability of each expert, disagreement with Global, and Global predicted-class one-hot. Anchored gate averages dynamic mixture with full PFN 50:50. No test inputs or labels enter fitting/selection.
evaluation: Freeze all methods and per-condition OOF parameters before panel predictions. Panel for all 60 conditions, exact full original test for the 12 conditions declared here irrespective of panel performance. Full evaluation is a precision expansion of the same inspected split, not independent confirmation. No test-metric-driven candidate selection. No global conflict filtering, test-label renormalization, or true-label query grouping.
metrics: Attack Macro-F1 on normal-inclusive population, all-class Macro-F1, benign FPR, attack detection recall, per-class precision/recall/F1, corrections and harms versus full PFN, disagreement and oracle ceiling diagnostic. Same-prediction attack-only sensitivity is secondary. Full test and weighted panels are reported separately.
cost: OOF preparation, full model fit/cache, per-component inference, mixture processing, and reference PFN16 inference separately. Ensemble cost includes every required component. No sparse-expert speed claim: every bank component is evaluated for this prototype.
analysis: Mean/sample SD and seed-paired differences for three sampling seeds. Test rows and exact-feature collisions are audited; group-disjoint OOF does not make the original outer test feature-disjoint. Tiny positive differences do not establish significance or novelty.
report: Korean standalone LaTeX with design, prior failures, literature-to-design mapping, complete numeric tables, plots, negative results, cost, next improvements, and validation. Temporary PDF compile, one-line log; no automatic manuscript/slides changes.
